hourly-demand.sql: SELECT hr, ROUND(AVG(cnt), 6), SUM(cnt) FROM rides GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr

weather-filter.sql: SELECT dteday, hr, cnt FROM rides WHERE weathersit = ? AND workingday = ? ORDER BY dteday, hr

season-summary.sql: SELECT season, yr, COUNT(*), ROUND(AVG(temp), 6), SUM(cnt) FROM rides GROUP BY season, yr ORDER BY season, yr
